system.story: The widest congregation - the purest expression of the Wired pet class.

description.value:
Subclass: Sprite-Weaver. You run the widest congregation of any Technomancer - the purest expression of the Wired "pet class."

Identity Feature - Wide Compile

You may keep more sprites compiled at once than the baseline cap and command them all with a single Compile Sprite maneuver; your congregation drip counts each sprite (up to 4 at Tier 5). The most conjured bodies on the board.

Signature Tweak

Your Swarm the Signal with three or more sprites adds an automatic Wired-condition rider on the target.

Bonus Skill + Contact

A second spirit/compiling skill (Rituals), plus a contact: a fellow-technomancer or spirit-broker (a bound sprite as a retainer-style follower).

Chrome Flavor

Minimal - the Weaver stays nearly pure (deepest Resonance).
